component.name: Yamep
component.summary: Markdown editor with a live preview

description.p: Yamep is a Markdown editor that shows a rendered preview beside the text as you type. Notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, so they stay readable without Yamep and work with any file sync client.

ul.li: Preview that follows the editor line by line, however tall an image renders
Toolbar for headings, lists, tables, code, links and task lists
File tree for the folder you are working in
Atomic saves, and a prompt when a note is changed on disk by another program
